title: RETRACTION: Future Warming Stimulates Growth and Photosynthesis in an Arctic Microalga More Strongly than Changes in Light Intensity or pCO2
content:
RETRACTION: S.D. Rokitta, C.H. Grossmann, E. Werner, J. Moye, G. Castellani, E.M. Nöthig, and B. Rost, “ Future Warming Stimulates Growth and Photosynthesis in an Arctic Microalga More Strongly than Changes in Light Intensity or pCO2 ,” Limnology and Oceanography 68, no. 12 (2023): 2789–2799, https://doi.org/10.1002/lno.12460.

The above article, published online on 29 November 2023 in Wiley Online Library (wileyonlinelibrary.com), has been retracted by agreement between the authors; the journal Editor-in-Chief, K. David Hambright; and John Wiley & Sons, Inc. The retraction has been agreed due to an error in the identification of a species in the study. Subsequent sequencing runs performed by the authors revealed that the alga species was not Phaeocystis pouchetii as originally reported but rather was identified as Isochrysis, a closely related haptophyte. As a result, the conclusions reported in the article are not considered reliable, as they pertain to a different taxon than originally reported. A revised version of this article will be submitted for consideration for publication.
